# NIBE Q3'26: Marginalerna fortsätter uppåt

**Feed**: inderes-se  
**Published**: 2026-11-20  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Inderes analyst Lukas reviews NIBE's Q3'26 report, in which operating profit rose 34% and beat both his forecast and consensus. It was the seventh straight quarter of organic growth and margin expansion, and the beat came mainly from the Element segment (semiconductor demand and electrification), not from the heat pumps in Climate Solutions. He raises the target price to SEK 49 and keeps an Accumulate (Öka) rating. His case rests on volumes coming back, operating leverage, and more bolt-on acquisitions now that net debt has fallen. The main risks he names are cuts to heat pump subsidies in Germany and the Netherlands, more competition and overcapacity, and a demanding valuation of about 27x this year's earnings.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 NIBE-B — Nibe | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Analyst (guest) Lukas keeps Öka (Accumulate) and raises target price to SEK 49 after Q3 EBIT +34% beat consensus; expects gradual recovery and good earnings growth.

#### Reasoning

Seventh straight quarter of organic growth and margin expansion suggests the recovery will last. Element beat on semiconductor and electrification demand. Volumes are returning, factories are not at full capacity, and structural cost cuts give operating leverage toward a ~13% margin. Lower net debt makes room for bolt-on acquisitions. At 27x this year's earnings the stock is not cheap, but multiples should come down as earnings grow, and expected total return is above the required return.

#### Sell Triggers

- if heat pump subsidies are cut in Germany or the Netherlands
- if overcapacity from industry factory investments leads to price pressure
- if increased competition prevents margin recovery toward ~13%
- if volume recovery stalls and earnings growth disappoints relative to the 27x multiple

> *"Vi tycker att givet den vinsttillväxt vi förväntar oss från Nibe och de värderingsultiplarna som bolaget handlas till framåtblickande så tycker vi att det finns en fortsatt god totalförväntad avkastning som överstiger vårt avkastningskrav och det är därför vi upprepar vår ökade rekommendation."*
